name: Monster Runners [Alpha]
desc:
⚠️WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS AND LOUD SOUNDS⚠️

Play on max graphics for the best experience.

You found this place. You entered it. Its your fault you're here. Get out while you still can.

[RUNNER]: Get to the elevator. Use your supplies and the environment to your advantage. Run like your life depends on it, because it does.

[MONSTER]: Kill everything that moves. Don't let anyone pass. This is what you always wanted.

[THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA: EXPECT BUGS]
